bottleneck_detail: VALU-throughput-bound on a software fp8(OCP)->fp16 conversion chain, NOT on MFMA. Inner KV loop = 2570 instrs of which only 16 are v_mfma_f32_32x32x8_f16 (the fp16 MFMA); the rest is per-element cndmask/cmp/shift/or fixup emitted because torch.float8_e4m3fn (OCP) cannot feed a gfx942 FNUZ fp8 MFMA.

ab_probe_m4096.note: standalone microbenchmark of an equivalent kernel body on GPU 0, M=N=4096 H=64 D=128. Direction signal only; full-benchmark decides.

ocp_to_fnuz_exactness.rule: e4m3fn and e4m3fnuz share the 4-bit exp / 3-bit mantissa layout and differ only by exponent bias 1 (factor 2) plus the 0x80 (neg-zero -> NaN) codepoint
ocp_to_fnuz_exactness.probe: as_fnuz(bits) * 2.0 == e4m3fn_value bit-exactly, max abs diff 0.0; 3320 0x80 bytes in Q and 47 in K all map to +0
ocp_to_fnuz_exactness.scale_fold: one scalar x4 total (x2 from Q, x2 from K) folded into the existing kv_scales / w_block multiply
ocp_to_fnuz_exactness.rule_compliance: reads only the 0x80 codepoint, never the data values -> does not exploit the fixed seed; is a format change, not a tolerance relaxation

top_opportunities: Eliminate the software fp8(OCP)->fp16 conversion and feed the native gfx942 FNUZ fp8 MFMA: view Q/K as uint8, scrub 0x80->0x00, bitcast to float8_e4m3fnuz, fold the resulting x4 into kv_scales/w_block. Inner loop is 2570 instrs for 16 fp16 MFMAs today; probe measured 3.771 -> 0.618 ms (6.1x) at M=4096. Fuse the scrub into the Triton load path (tl.where on the uint8 bits + tl.bitcast), NOT host-side torch passes, to avoid adding dispatches inside the timed region.

Re-open the tile choice once fp8 is native: _gfx942_default_tile_fits_lds models the fp16-expansion path, but native fp8 halves the KV tile. BLOCK_KV=128/num_stages=2 measured 0.618 ms vs 1.063 ms at 64/1 (1.7x on top of #1); 256/2 regressed to 0.798 ms and bf16 256/2 hit the 64 KiB LDS wall. Update the gate function rather than bypassing it.
Drop input_precision="ieee" on the tl.dot: with native fp8 operands the accumulate is already fp32 and 'ieee' may force a slower expansion path. Cheap A/B, must stay under err_ratio <= 0.02.

Avoid the full torch.full(-inf) output prefill: FillFunctor<float> costs ~178 us on the M=8000 case inside the timed region and cu_starts=0/cu_ends=N means the kernel writes every element anyway. Use torch.empty when the window is provably full, or store -inf from the masked tail. ~1% now, ~10% after #1.

Re-read the latency C1/C2 split after #1+#2 land: 108+132 VGPRs -> 2 waves/SIMD (25%), but with a 2570-instr dependency-light loop that is currently adequate. Once the loop shrinks ~100x the kernel will likely flip to issue-wait-dominant, making Accum_VGPR reduction / waves_per_eu a real lever. Do NOT pre-tune registers now.
